findings: Coverage: all 297 .qml (QuickSettings 165, InputPicker 51, ContextMenu 14, ScreenRemote 57, BootLogo 5, MasterBrand 5) are named in a row's evidence/size or in a (no UI)/(unused) row; checked by script (297/297).

Opening calls: QuickSettings = Settings key RELEASE (appLaunch.js openSettings -> luna://com.webos.service.systemUIManager/launch {appId:com.webos.app.quicksettings}) or luna://com.webos.surfacemanager/showQuickSettings; InputPicker = Key_Video / webOS_InputSource / LocalInputSource or surfacemanager/showInputPicker; ScreenRemote = Key_webOS_ScreenRemote (hotkey) or livemenu with activateType numerickeys.

Boot preload: appLaunch.js preloadSystemUI() launches quicksettings and quickinputpicker with reason=preload after boot (QS loads hidden then exits; InputPicker exits at once). Replacing QS must handle launch payload {params, reason:'preload'} and params.activateType.

Live state on this TV: settingsservice other.quickSettingsMenuList = picture, OledLcdBrightness, timer, game, screenOff, energySaving (6 of max 12); recent = energySaving. profile.list has hdmi, mrcu, musicRecognition, thinq, tts, universalControl; NO gaming/wee/touchScreen/battery/monitor/hdmiTx. OLED=true, localKeyType=onekey, supportWirelessAV=false, seniorMode.support=false, usageCare.support=true, customization.support=false.

Unreachable on this set: Easy/Senior panel, QS local-key guidance and game local-key guidance (need joystick local key), Touch Lock, Battery Brightness, Wireless AV, External Devices tiles, customised boot/power-off logos. Music Search needs an LG server answer (sdx services_info music_discovery) so is likely hidden while LG hosts are blocked [INFERENCE].

Game Dashboard replaces the normal QS panel when gameMode[input]=on AND game picture/sound mode AND enableQuickGame AND the HDMI input app is foreground (not multi-view dual monitor). It is therefore a mode of the Settings key, not a separate key. The Settings key doc string says game users reach normal QS by turning Game Dashboard off in Game Optimizer.

Delete-tile confirmation, Sound Out Bluetooth guide, Touch Lock confirm, InputPicker network/USB alerts and all 'not available' toasts are NOT drawn by these modules: they call com.webos.notification createAlert/createToast, so a replacement must also replace or restyle the notification layer; alert buttons call systemUIManager/launch back into QS with params.action (remove, btDeeplink, touchLockOn).
Dead code in QS: ControlPanelItemDeleteDecisionPopup, CanvasImageButton, DingbatButton, GamingBackButton, SimpleButton have no references.

ContextMenu is only the pointer right-click menu with exactly two buttons (Back, Home), caller 'mouseclick' only (PredefinedAppList.js); launched natively by libStarfishInput handleRightMouseClick with {caller,x,y}; window only shows if the cursor is visible; it then injects Back/Home key to the previously focused window. Not a long-press home/app-card menu.

InputPicker input list comes from luna eim getAllInputStatus: only connected inputs with hdmiPlugIn true are tiles (this TV at snapshot: HDMI 2 with CEC name AVR-S760H). Repeated Input key press advances the focus and a 5 s idle timer auto-launches the focused tile (hotkey navigation). Default 'Home Hub' tile always first (com.webos.app.homeconnect). MRCU interface sets hotkey cursor policy for button 19 while open.

ScreenRemote shows 'More Actions' side panel whose content depends on foreground app: in Netflix/YouTube-class cards only Quit App, User Guide, Information, Quick Help (non-JP), Sports modes if supported; TV-only functions need Live TV input; Universal Control keys need an IR/IP/IoT device set up. If no button exists it toasts 'This function is not available now.' and closes. KeyFilters skip it when the foreground app sets handleScreenRemoteKey or screensaver is foreground; in multi-view it opens multiviewsettings/home showOption instead.

BootLogo is launched by /usr/sbin/bootd (not by compositor QML) via systemUIManager/launch with type 'swatch' and closed by closeByAppId; /etc/palm/bootd.json homeAnimation {format:swatch, fadeOutDuration:1200, waitAfterHome:3}. MasterBrand is launched by the compositor on tvpower power-off-logo request and stays about 3 s; it is closed forcibly if power state becomes active. Both use ScreenCover/screencover windows; assets: BootLogo animated 'webOS' wordmark sprite (230315_360x115_sprite.png), MasterBrand LG_logo_2k/4k.png.
